stops.name: Côte de granite rose
stops.detail: The Côte de granite rose or Pink Granite Coast (Breton: Arvor greunvaen roz) is a stretch of coastline in the Côtes d'Armor departement of northern Brittany, France. It stretches for more than thirty kilometres from Plestin-les-Grèves to Louannec, encompassing Trégastel.
